name: SARRSD
description: Object detection is a crucial task in the field of computer vision. Due to advancements in deep learning technologies over the past decade, significant progress has been made in object detection. However, these developments have lagged in their application to microwave radar remote sensing imagery. This gap arises not only from the unique characteristics and differences between microwave radar imaging and optical imaging but also because of the substantial disparities in shape and texture between targets in remote sensing images and ground objects in general scenarios. Additionally, there is a scarcity of high-quality annotated datasets for remote sensing scenarios, and microwave radar remote sensing target datasets remain limited in scale. To advance research on mapping-type and recognition-type target detection in microwave radar remote sensing, we introduce the Large-Scale Microwave Radar Remote Sensing Mapping-Type and Recognition-Type Object Detection Dataset (SARRSD). This datase
reputation: A specialized remote-sensing detection benchmark aimed at microwave radar imagery, with limited but growing use in that subcommunity.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; domain shift from optical to microwave radar imagery makes it challenging, and public adoption is likely still limited.
